findings.title: Requirement snapshots bypass source document read ACL
findings.observed: Same-tenant viewer receives 403 for private document but 200 for deterministic requirement module head and snapshot.json containing PRIVATE SECRET. Source publication newly introduces private domain data into tenant-readable native storage.
findings.reproduction: Create requirement, set visibility private, owner submits snapshot. Add same-tenant viewer. Derive requirement- + SHA256(doc_id), get head revision, fetch snapshot.json using viewer session.
findings.expected: Current source read ACL must govern all native read/revision/head/composition paths exposing protected snapshot data; module/snapshot binding must not be forgeable through generic batch writes. ACL revocation and historical revisions must remain protected.

findings.title: Invalid Unicode base escapes input validation and returns 500
findings.observed: Valid source_version with base containing lone surrogate, either string or nested mapping, raises UnicodeEncodeError at snapshot binding encoding; HTTP returns 500. Integer base=7 correctly returns422.
findings.expected: Validate base type/revision format before serialization and return422 for invalid Unicode, with no native write.

import sys,json,tempfile,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd();sys.path[:0]=[str(root/'customizations/components/tianxuan/server'),str(root/'customizations/components/tianxuan/duobao')]
from api import create_app
from tianxuan_core import Tianxuan
from native_store import NativeStore
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from test_native_api import account
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
 s=Tianxuan(':memory:');n=NativeStore(Path(tmp)/'n.db');c=TestClient(create_app(s,native_store=n,native_only=True),raise_server_exceptions=False)
 a,h=account(c,801);aid=a['user_id'];d=s.create_requirement(aid,'r','PRIVATE SECRET','o','s','a');s.set_visibility(aid,d['id'],'private');p='/api/v1/native/requirements/'+d['id'];v=c.get(p+'/source',headers=h).json()['source_version']
 for base in ['\ud800', {'bad':'\ud800'}]:
  base=json.loads(json.dumps(base).replace('\\ud800','\ud800'))
  r=c.post(p+'/snapshots',headers=h,content=json.dumps(dict(request_key='bad-base',source_version=v,base=base)));print('invalid base:',r.status_code,'expected 422')
 saved=c.post(p+'/snapshots',headers=h,json=dict(request_key='valid',source_version=v,base=None)).json()
 member=s.add_member(aid,'v@example.invalid','password123',role='viewer')['user_id'];mh={'Authorization':'Bearer '+s.issue_session(member)}
 print('private doc:',c.get('/api/v1/docs/'+d['id'],headers=mh).status_code)
 module='requirement-'+hashlib.sha256(d['id'].encode()).hexdigest();head=c.get('/api/v1/native/modules/'+module+'/head',headers=mh)
 print('head:',head.status_code)
 obj=c.get('/api/v1/native/modules/'+module+'/revisions/'+head.json()['revision']+'/objects/snapshot.json',headers=mh)
 print('private snapshot:',obj.status_code,'PRIVATE SECRET' in obj.text,'expected denial')
 s.db.close()
